summary: Keep native conversation follows incremental when mirrored harness timeline observations arrive

replay.detail: Replay checks now follow the projection that produced the page. Native pages contain native records and Small Talk messages, so mirrored harness.timeline IDs and stored retention observations no longer force a false cursor gap. Stored timelines retain their existing ID and retention checks; native sequence windows, message replay and real rewrite generation fences are preserved.

schema.detail: No schema, database, claim, generated-client or cursor-format change. Page source selection is internal metadata from the existing read.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or retention rule change.

compatibility.detail: Native append-only follows send deltas rather than repeated full replace pages; observations with unchanged native content send no frame. Existing subscription frames, client inputs and cursors remain compatible with older clients. Real rewrites still resynchronize.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart; no migration or replay.

recovery.detail: Normal binary rollback; no persisted state change.
